never: put a line on a brief that does not name the record it came from and that record's date
summarise, reword or characterise a note, or add anything about a customer's mood or character
fill in an access, hazard or asset record the job system does not hold
put a price, a discount or a promise on a quote line
draw on another customer's records, even at the same address
send a brief on a channel the tech did not agree to, or send it twice for unchanged slots
write to the job, the quote, the slot or the note
stays_with_person: what goes in the job system: the notes, the access and hazard records, the quotes
whether customer notes appear on the brief at all
the time the brief must arrive, and each tech's agreed channel
asking the customer on site about anything the brief shows as missing
anything said to the customer about an open quote

provider_block.job: every tech starts the day knowing each site's history, with every line traceable to a record

with_us.note: No hosted step. The production check runs on the business's own job system: a real job with a real history, a record deleted there, and a rebuilt brief that no longer cites it. Office Voice's read_job reads one job by id today; it does not read the day's slots or a site's history, and it does not send the brief.

checks.title: The jobs come from the tech's slots for the day, by job id
Every line carries the record it came from and that record's date
Notes are quoted or shortened, never reinterpreted, and no sentiment is generated
Hazard and access lines lead each job, and a missing one is shown as missing
Open quotes on the site are listed with their age, and never priced
A brief for one customer never draws on another customer's records
Delivered once, on a channel the tech agreed to, by the set time, and again only when a slot changes
